description_en: LAND FOR SALE - NEAR VODAFONE ALBANIA (KASHARË) 600 m² for sale, surrounded by a wall, in Kashar, near Vodafone Albania, 200 m from the highway (without crossing the lane). Regular documents. The price of €180,000 is debatable
